descriptionChirho: The proper masculine name Abinadab (Hebrew אֲבִינָדָב), referring to several individuals in the Hebrew Bible. All 12 occurrences represent the same lexical item with only grammatical variation (bare noun vs. conjunction-prefixed). Evidence across translations is uniform: eng 'Abinadab/Avinadav', spa 'Abinadab/Avinadav', hin अबीनादाब, arb أَبِينَادَاب, kor 아비나답, swa 'Abinadabu/Abinadab'. The conjunction-prefixed form (S79619 'and-Abinadab') is purely syntactic.
